caseStudies.title: How a high-volume kitchen in Jaipur cut LPG costs, simplified operations, and kept consistent quality with on2cook.
caseStudies.cardExcerpt: How a high-volume kitchen in Jaipur cut LPG costs, simplified operations, and kept consistent quality with on2cook.

snapshot.description: Chef N Dish (Kabulee Kitchen) runs a high-volume cloud kitchen out of Jaipur, serving North Indian gravies, Chinese, and desserts. Handling 200-250 orders a day, the kitchen needed a way to keep up without rising costs or inconsistent results.

challenge.title: High LPG Dependency Slowing Down a Growing Kitchen
challenge.description: Keeping up with daily demand meant relying on 5-6 LPG cylinders every month. As the kitchen got busier, costs kept climbing — training new staff took weeks and so did the pressure on cooks to keep every dish consistent.
points: High monthly cost of ₹13,000–17,000 from 5-6 LPG cylinders
Taste consistency dependent on skilled cooks
Food wastage adding to daily costs
6-member kitchen staff needed to manage volume

solution.title: Switching to
solution.description: Chef N Dish brought in 3 On2Cook units to replace LPG-based cooking. With standardized, 6-in-1 cooking technology, the kitchen could run leaner without compromising on taste.
points: Replaced LPG cylinders with O2Cook’s Smart cooking Technology
Ran the entire kitchen with just 2 cooks
Cut food wastage from 8–10% down to just 1–2%
Delivered consistent taste across every batch

results.title: A Leaner Kitchen, With Taste Consistency
results.description: With on2cook, Chef N Dish now runs a leaner kitchen with higher profit margins, lower dependency on skilled chefs, and the same consistent taste in every order. Cooking that once took 35 minutes now takes just 12, and training a new hire has dropped from weeks to a few days — letting the kitchen run on 4 staff instead of 6 while handling 60% more orders, even through Zomato/Swiggy rush. It's also freed up kitchen staff to handle other tasks while the cooking runs on its own.

caseStudies.title: How a cloud kitchen in Ahmedabad standardized its menu and grew nearly 4X with On2Cook.
caseStudies.cardExcerpt: How Jad's Kitchen Built a More Consistent Kitchen with On2Cook

snapshot.description: Jad's Kitchen is a cloud kitchen based in Ahmedabad, handling close to 150 orders a day. Built on standardized cooking and consistent taste, the kitchen grew its business into a recognizable, repeatable food experience.

challenge.title: Keeping a Diverse Menu Consistent, Order After Order
challenge.description: As Jad's Kitchen grew, keeping taste, colour and texture consistent across every order became harder — without depending entirely on LPG cylinders or skilled kitchen staff.
points: High dependency on LPG cylinders for everyday cooking
Consistent taste, colour and aroma across a varied menu
Heavy reliance on skilled chefs for repeatable results
Food wastage adding to costs at scale

solution.title: Standardizing Taste with
solution.description: Jad's Kitchen used On2Cook to cook its core menu — North Indian gravies, biryanis, Chicken Schezwan, Chinese recipes, Dal Fry, mutton and egg — with standardized, repeatable results.
points: Zero dependency on LPG cylinders for everyday cooking
Consistent taste, colour and aroma across every dish
Reduced dependency on skilled kitchen staff
Less food wastage, cooking exactly what's required

results.title: From Consistent Taste to 4X Growth
results.description:
Jad's Kitchen began this phase of its journey at around 40 daily orders. Using On2Cook to standardize cooking across its menu, the business built a stronger foundation of consistent taste and repeatable quality.

Today, Jad's Kitchen handles close to 150 orders a day, nearly 4X where it started, with On2Cook helping shape the consistent food experience behind that growth.

caseStudies.title: How Haldiram scaled operations and delighted more customers with On2Cook.
caseStudies.cardExcerpt: How a fast-growing cafe chain improved order consistency, reduced manual effort, and enhanced customer experience with on2cook.

snapshot.description: Haldiram is one of India's most beloved food brands, known for its wide range of sweets, snacks, and savory delights. With a legacy dating back to 1937, Haldiram has built a strong presence across the country, serving millions of customers with taste and trust.

challenge.title: Inconsistent Quality, High Manual Effort & Longer Preparation Time
challenge.description: With a wide variety of menu items and high footfall across outlets, Haldiram's faced challenges in maintaining consistent taste and quality. Manual cooking processes led to longer preparation times, higher dependency on skilled staff, and operational inefficiencies.
points: Inconsistent taste and quality across outlets
High manual effort and dependency on skilled staff
Longer cooking times affecting order turnaround
Higher food wastage and operational costs

solution.title: Switching to
solution.description: Haldiram's partnered with on2cook to bring automation and precision to their kitchens. With standardized recipes, intelligent cooking, and consistent execution, on2cook helped streamline operations across all outlets.
points: Standardized recipes & automated cooking
Reduced dependency on skilled staff
Faster cooking with consistent quality
Better control on costs & wastage

results.title: The Results
results.description: On2cook delivered tangible outcomes that strengthened operations and customer experience.
points: Consistent taste and quality across all outlets
Faster service and reduced wait times
Lower operational costs and food waste
Happier customers and higher retention
